body.name: [\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p),\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)]
body.construction: \(\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)=\min\{q_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho):\rho\in\mathfrak O_H(p)\}\) and \(\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)=\max\{q_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho):\rho\in\mathfrak O_H(p)\}\). These are the exact extrema over the single complete temporal-order common-latent SCM class subject to the observational equations \(P_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=p\).
